# DevTrack

> Developer progress dashboard. Log what you shipped, the DSA problems you solved, and the projects you moved forward — and watch the pattern emerge across weeks. Real-time sync across tabs via Supabase Realtime.

DevTrack is a side project by Shailesh Chaudhari (Software Engineer at ContextQA, Ahmedabad, India). Author portfolio: https://shaileshchaudhari.vercel.app.

## Live

- App: https://daily-dev-track.vercel.app
- Source: https://github.com/Shailesh93602/devtrack

## Why this exists

Most "habit trackers" are clean but boring. Most "developer dashboards" lock you into one ecosystem (GitHub commits only, or Leetcode only). DevTrack lets you log free-text — "shipped Razorpay webhook idempotency", "solved 3 DP problems", "added auth to side project" — and aggregates the streak across kinds. The interesting build detail is the live multi-tab sync via Supabase Realtime postgres_changes subscription on `daily_logs`: edit on phone, see the desktop tab update sub-second.

## Tech stack

- **Frontend**: Next.js 15 (App Router), React, Tailwind CSS, Recharts
- **Backend / data**: Supabase (Postgres + Realtime + Auth), Prisma ORM
- **Realtime**: `postgres_changes` subscription scoped per-user → optimistic UI on the writing tab, pushed update on the reading tab
- **Hosting**: Vercel
